assets.text_policy: exact title and subtitle only, in a quiet right-side panel; no other copy
assets.prompt_recipe: Anime-inspired editorial hero illustration, wide cinematic composition. A focused developer at a warm evening desk slides a single glowing rounded module pack into an open laptop whose screen shows a repository tree of folders and files as clean abstract shapes. Around the laptop, three friendly helmeted agent figures light up checkpoint nodes along a branching route diagram of soft neon connector lines. A small companion robot holds a checklist with green check marks and one red X. Cozy workspace in blue-violet night light with a warm desk lamp. A quiet right-side panel is the only lettering in the image, set in crisp readable type: title 'One pack. Any repo.' and subtitle 'The multi-agent hotloader gives your coding agents roles, a decision boss, and proposals that become PRs'. Every other surface in the scene stays free of words, labels, numbers, and logos.
assets.exact_subtitle: The multi-agent hotloader gives your coding agents roles, a decision boss, and proposals that become PRs
